notes.title: She And The Light Bearer is Taking Part in Woman's Day Sale!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32648144/f78b9ec183fed8871eb3aa392e921c9630f6edb2.png

Happy International Women's Day! 

Hello, Light Bearers!

We wish for all the women around the world to achieve their best whether in their lives, also in the gaming industry. Come and celebrate together with the Women's Day Sale where She and The Light Bearer is participating together with lots of different games by wondrous developers around the world! 

Let's give huge warm hugs to Co-Founder of Mojiken Studio, Brigitta Rena. She's also the art director for both When the Past was Around and She and the Light Bearer. There are many cute creatures that are favored by our female fans in She and The Light Bearer, you know? ːheartrisː

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32648144/aa3d01d92087229b76d2cc465f95b8845c84a1b5.png
The cute art to celebrate  She and the Light Bearer 3 years anniversary made by Brigitta Rena

A huge thanks to WINGS Team, a venture that loves to support games made by diverse teams of women and minority game developers, for supporting this event. Let's celebrate together and spread the love for everyone who also taking part in this wonderful occasion! 

She and the Light Bearer is 60% off during the Women's Day Sale. The event ends on March 11th, 10 am PT.

Thank you so much for your support towards She and the Light Bearer!

Please stay safe and healthy, friends!

notes.title: She and the Light Bearer Trading Cards Now Available
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32648144/67081f58fe8e8eed618824d02fd2ac16451bccb0.png

Hello, Light Bearers!

Long time no see! How are you all? We hope you’re all safe and healthy.

We are truly happy to announce that She and the Light Bearer trading cards are now available on Steam! Now whenever you play the game, you will be able to unlock and earn profile backgrounds, trading cards, and emoticons that you can use on Steam chat. Yay!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32648144/3554bc137cf37ebfc1099cf91641a8b7074b3684.gif

You will be able to collect a set of eight unique cards featuring Little Firefly and their forest friends, and craft them into upgradable She and the Light Bearer game badges that you can display on your Steam profile. We hope you love them!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32648144/843f31c42490b30ffa89616c9fc2930a0016e1a6.jpg

Oh, and another good news!

We will release another game called When the Past was Around also by us, Mojiken Studio and Toge Productions, coming 22nd September 2020.

Check out the trailer here:
https://youtu.be/0Ayvr0pILnU

And don’t forget to wishlist the game!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1164050/When_The_Past_Was_Around/

Thank you very much for you support for She and the Light Bearer!

Please stay safe!

- - - - -

notes.title: When the Past was Around - Coming on Sep 22, 2020!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5485678/fc8b824047bbdf28662d8f9aa9501219332f9128.png

Frem the creators of A Raven Monologue and Coffee Talk.

We are very delighted to announce that our project, When the Past was Around by Mojiken Studio and Toge Productions will be available on Steam on September 22, 2020.

When the Past was Around is an adventure puzzle-escape game about love, loss, moving on, and letting go. Experience the ups and downs with Eda and Owl.

Watch the announcement trailer here:
https://youtu.be/0Ayvr0pILnU

Follow and wishlist the game now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1164050/When_The_Past_Was_Around/

If you've played our previously released game, A Raven Monologue and She and the Light Bearer, you will enjoy this game as well. 


Wish us luck for the release!

Have a great day/evening!

notes.title: Здравствуйте! She and the Light Bearer Now Available in Russian
notes.content:
Hello, dear Light Bearers!

If you notice, we have an update for the game a while ago, and some of you might be wondering what was the update about.

We are happy to announce that She and the Light Bearer now has Russian in the language option! She and the Light Bearer теперь доступна и на русском языке! We hope this will let more people enjoy the story of Firefly's journey with the help of forest friends to find Mother.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32648144/dc7ac84a58d1af11f881e7b290e8bd4f2a76cff8.png

And we want to thank our beloved Light Bearer, Solomon, for translating the game into Russian! Solomon has been very helpful to us and glad to have him as part of our community.

Have a wonderful day, Light Bearers!

notes.title: When the Past Was Around - Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
Hello, light bearers!

Mojiken Studio, the developer of She and the Light Bearer hold Mojiken Camp a while ago, where all the team members did brainstorming together and had to some up with a game idea within a week. Sort of an internal game jam, yes. And we are more than happy to present on of the games that were made, from the creator of She and the Light Bearer.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32648144/212b91d7bd5df332d7808cdae37f5f0a1178cef3.gif

When the Past Was Around

Something is missing from her world.
 
But she can neither remember nor forget.
Like music from her adolescent days, 
its tunes resonates, yet its verses have gone silent.
Like a beast who stalked in her dreams,
its eyes call her, yet its name has been lost.
It's been far too long, but she's back here again.
 
In a place, When the Past Was Around.

When the Past was Around tells a tale between a girl and a beast in a surreal world. The girl must find a way to unravel secrets, secrets which she used to know.


Demo available on itch.io

You can play the demo for free on our itch.io page!
Simply go the link below.

mojiken.itch.io/when-the-past-was-around

Please show some some love and support for the game and feel free to share this on your social media using the hashtag #whenthepastwasaround

Have a great day, light bearers!
